title: Right / left movements (GMM)
summary: Same 5-minute recording as experiment 02 (right, left and up-left-down movements), grouped with a Gaussian Mixture Model instead of k-means. The GMM gives each window a probability of belonging to each group, and the BIC suggests the number of groups from the data alone.
result: To be filled in after running build_results.py
method: Gaussian Mixture Model on 4 s windows (k = 4, diagonal covariance), angles relative to the resting position
